items.title: 4.3.2 Combining Stack and Graph to perform DFS (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of DFS with a stack (PDF 118-120).

blocks.text: DFS graph ya tree ko shaakh mein jitna aage ja sake khangalta phir wapas aata hai, aur baqi nodes rakhne ke liye stack istemal karta hai. Misal: tree jis ki jarr 1; bachche 2, 3 aur 4; 2 ke neeche 5 aur 6; 3 ke neeche 7; 4 ke neeche 8 aur 9 (Figure 4.13).

blocks.alt: Teeron wala dairon ka tree: oopar 1 se 2, 3 aur 4; 2 se 5 aur 6; 3 se 7; 4 se 8 aur 9.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.13: Adadi nodes wale tree ki graph shakal (kitab ki Figure 4.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: DFS tarteeb 1, 2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8, 9 hai. Bachche ulti tarteeb mein push hote hain ta ke sab se baen bachcha top par ho aur pehle dekha jaye.

blocks.prompt: Long question 7(a): jis graph mein A se B, C aur D, B se E aur F, C se G, aur D se H aur I ki taraf teer hain, A se DFS tarteeb dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Parosiyon ko haroof-e-tahaji ki tarteeb mein le kar: A, B, E, F, C, G, D, H, I.

items: 9 nodes wale tree par stack wala DFS: 1, 2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8, 9.
